results.finding: sections, unit counts and unit forms match the spec
All 61 outline summaries match the controlling idea of their aligned spec paragraph, in spec order.
Setting the Scene ¶4 (p10): the diagnosis and Noor's W5 addition are one idea with its consequence, as the spec declares.
Rate Limits ¶3 (p43): the shared bucket is part of why the hourly push 'will sometimes not finish'; one idea (what published limits mean for the stock push) with two consequences.

Every body unit ties to S1-S5: contract and rate limits to S1, changing/versioning to S2, deprecation to S3, webhooks to S4, ownership, trade-offs, stages and card to S5; the introduction, failures and conclusion frame or synthesize them.

Each table, figure and quotation has an adjacent sentence saying what it shows (e.g. p12 after the four-part table, p20 after AIP-180/Zalando, p27 'more dangerous, because it is silent', p38 'Read the table as a contract', p53 after the card).

results.quote: **Where we are in the order's journey.** Eva's jacket reaches the warehouse through a platform notification.
results.finding: Declared 'example' carrying Kestrel & Pine's contracts as consumer and provider at the start of the paragraph; the opening sentence starts from the book's journey label and Eva's jacket and picks up nothing from p03.
